title: Retire the legacy task-sync baseline export_basis field in the next full-store migration batch
outcome: Retire the legacy task-sync baseline export_basis field in the next full-store migration batch
acceptance: The next full-store migration conversion removes export_basis from task_sync_import_planning records and the work_task_sync_baseline_heads projection, reporting the count of converted records, with record ids and links unchanged
Nothing reads or writes export_basis after the conversion; folder import and export compare only the additive inventory_root
The conversion runs in the same stopped-consumer window as the source_revision column retirement
